labels.cavity_roots: FACT standard EM: spherical PEC cavity lowest TM (root of [x j1(x)]' = 2.744) and TE (root of j1 = 4.493); e.g. Harrington, Time-Harmonic Electromagnetic Fields (1961) §6-9; Balanis, Advanced Engineering Electromagnetics 2nd ed. §10.4
labels.probe_anchor_*: FACT/DIGITIZED Tekbox TBPS01/TBWA2 manual V2.2 (https://www.tekbox.com/product/TBPS01_TBWA2_Manual.pdf) p.2 Picture 2 (H probes, output dBm at 1 uT) and p.3 Picture 3 (E5, output dBm at 1 V/m). Anchor points = the chart's data points extracted from the PDF vector paths (not hand-read), rounded to 0.1 dB and nominal MHz. Between anchors: linear in log10(f) = INTERPOLATED. Outside anchor range = NOT PUBLISHED
labels.faq_v11: FACT Tekbox 'FAQ Near Field Probes' V1.1 26-Jan-2022 p.2 (https://www.tekbox.com/product/FAQ_Near_Field_Probes.pdf): B[T]=10^((Pout-S-20log10 F_MHz)/20), S: H20 80, H10 62, H5 40 ('H field scaling factors corrected'); E[V/m]=10^((Pout+112.5-20log10 F_MHz)/20). V1.0 (2019) had S=76/56/47 (superseded)
labels.tinysa_floor: FACT tinysa.org TinySA4.Specification: lowest discernible signal -102 dBm @30 MHz, RBW 30 kHz (no LNA); -145 dBm @30 MHz, RBW 200 Hz (LNA, NF 5 dB); RBW list; best < -25 dBm; P1dB -1 dBm; abs max +6 dBm. Scaling 10log10(RBW/RBW_ref) = FACT (thermal noise ∝ bandwidth); applying the 30 MHz spec at 433 MHz–3 GHz = ASSUMPTION

labels.openems.seam_default: ASSUMPTION: one 30 mm x 1 mm gap in the copper tape (replaces the v0.1 assumed 5 mm analytic seam); user-selectable
labels.openems.scaling: FACT linear system: fields scale with source EMF -> x 10^((P_dBm - 2)/20). Transfer of 10 mm-gap slot tables to the 200 mm page geometry at equal available power = ASSUMPTION (openEMS exterior fields in the 200 mm geometry are 0.33-0.40x the 10 mm ones, so interior leakage is probably overestimated ~2.5-3x = conservative against claiming an EED signal)
labels.lineN: numerical: midpoint-rule elements for the line-current exterior model (JS and WL identical)

interior_standard: ideal closed conductor: E = 0, B = 0  # FACT
E_ref = V0/R  # FACT electrostatics, surface field of a sphere at potential V0 (page uses V0/R)

SE_wall = A + R + B (Schelkunoff, plane wave, normal incidence): A = 8.686*Re(gamma)*t; R = 20log10|(eta0+eta)^2/(4 eta0 eta)|; B = 20log10|1 - ((eta0-eta)/(eta0+eta))^2 exp(-2 gamma t)|; gamma = sqrt(j w mu (sigma_t + j w eps)), eta = j w mu / gamma  # FACT form (Schelkunoff 1943; Ott, Electromagnetic Compatibility Engineering 2009 ch.6)
SE_seam = max(0, 20log10(lambda/(2 l)) - 10log10(n)) for l < lambda/2 else 0  # FACT form (Ott 2009 §6.6 aperture/slot; plane-wave, thin sheet)
SE_shell = -10log10(10^(-SE_wall/10) + 10^(-SE_seam/10))  # ASSUMPTION: incoherent power sum of leakage paths
E_leak = E_ref*10^(-SE_shell/20), uniform in r  # ASSUMPTION (no seam-position dependence)
interior_HYP: E_r(r) = V0 R [sin kr - kr cos kr]/(r^2 sin kR), k = 2 pi f / C0  # HYP, exactly as future-scalar-ab.html#eed
E_r(0) = 0; series near 0: V0 R k^3 r/(3 sin kR)
B = 0 (EED SLW mode, page: 'The field is radial (longitudinal), zero at the center, and has B = 0')  # HYP
exterior_standard: Q = 4 pi eps0 R V0  # FACT isolated-sphere capacitance; ignoring counterpoise proximity = ASSUMPTION
Model A (isolated sphere, quasi-static): E = V0 R / r_c^2, B = 0  # FACT electrostatics, valid r << lambda/2pi and far from counterpoise

Model B (default): uniform line current I0 = w Q from image centre (z=-h_c) to sphere centre (z=+h_c), superposition of N Hertzian elements  # ASSUMPTION (uniform in-phase current, all charge on sphere, infinite ground plane image)
Model C: single Hertzian dipole I l = w (2 h_c Q) at the ground plane  # ASSUMPTION (point dipole)

Hertzian element (Balanis, Antenna Theory 3rd ed. Eq. 4-8a,b,c/4-10): E_r = eta Il cos(th)/(2 pi r^2) [1 + 1/(jkr)] e^-jkr; E_th = j eta k Il sin(th)/(4 pi r) [1 + 1/(jkr) - 1/(kr)^2] e^-jkr; H_ph = j k Il sin(th)/(4 pi r) [1 + 1/(jkr)] e^-jkr  # FACT form
probe position: sphere-centre height h_c = gap + R, horizontal distance r_c = R + d from sphere centre

P_rad(B) = 1/2 * full-space radiated power of a uniform line current of length L = 2 h_c: (Z0 k^2 I0^2 L^2/(32 pi^2)) * 2 pi * Int_0^pi sin^3(th) [sin(u)/u]^2 dth, u = k L cos(th)/2  # FACT form (Balanis ch.4 far-zone line source; half-space by image theory)
P_rad(C) = 0.5 * Z0 (pi/3) (I l/lambda)^2, 1/lambda = k/(2 pi)  # FACT form (Balanis Eq. 4-16, halved for half-space above the ground plane)
power limit (default ON): if P_rad(model) > P_drive then E,B scaled by sqrt(P_drive/P_rad)  # ASSUMPTION (energy-conservation bound; the 50-ohm V0 identity over-drives Models B/C)
exterior_HYP: SleeveBalunSNR carry-over: P_rad = I_pk^2 Z0/(4 pi) (US 9,306,527 Eq.15); S = P_rad/(4 pi r_c^2) * exp(-alpha L); E_par = sqrt(S Z0)  # HYP / illustrative cartoon
exterior_openEMS: points (d_i, E_i, B_i) = near-field equatorial samples (non-null) + far-field points (d = r_ff - R); sorted by d
d_first <= d <= d_last: ln E and ln B piecewise-linear in ln d (log-log interpolation); exact sample -> sample value
d > d_last: E = E_last (R + d_last)/(R + d) (far-field 1/r, FACT)
d < d_first: no openEMS data -> analytic model (labelled)
scale s = 10^((P_dBm - P_ref_dBm)/20), P_ref = +2 dBm available (50-ohm source)
dataset used when |f - f_i| <= 1e-6 f_i, |R - R_i| <= 1e-6 m, counterpoise ON, |gap - gap_i| <= 1e-6 m; else analytic only
extModel 'auto' (default) = openEMS when available, else Model B (counterpoise) / A
interior_openEMS: seam option in openems.seam_options; table = interior.cases[seam][dir] (dir eq = toward the seam, axis = vertical axis, obl = 45 deg)
|E|(r/R): sample x_i = xE; exact sample -> E_i; between samples: if both > 0, ln E linear in r/R, else linear; r/R >= last sample -> last value (clamped); same for |B| with xB
openEMS tables only for f = 433.59 MHz and R = 0.14 m; otherwise and for seam 'analytic': v0.1 analytic wall + seam model (labelled analytic only)
stack_standard: sum of SE_layer (Schelkunoff A+R+B form above) over checked layers + 2*att_tent  # layers in series, inter-layer reflections ignored = ASSUMPTION
ocean_air_toy / free_space: no standard attenuation defined (0 dB)
stack_HYP: SleeveBalunSNR carry-over: Errata alpha=0 (default) -> no loss; Exp-C Ohmic ON -> alphaL = alpha_toy * sum(L of checked segments) [+ alpha_toy*2*cage_path if cage Ohmic] [+ alpha_extra*L_extra]; power survival exp(-alphaL); mesh mP applied to detector power (as SNR_Hively)
probe: P_probe_dBm = K(f) + 20 log10(field/ref) - stack_dB; K from manual V2.2 curve (default) or FAQ V1.1 formula
field amplitude convention: peak amplitude used, as the page does (Tekbox does not state rms vs peak)  # ASSUMPTION
flags: f_TM101 = 2.744 C0/(2 pi R); f_TE101 = 4.493 C0/(2 pi R)  # FACT standard
